name: simulate-inherited-ira-boundary
why: Measured reach for the grouped annual inherited-IRA distribution planner and shared applicable-plan identity boundary. Nine block-O members exercise legacy and classified schedules, S2 pre/post-election and death-year behavior, final sweeps, dead beneficiaries, Roth character, zero-movement sub-cent shortfalls, compatible duplicate physical rows represented by one logical ID, ordered application, applicable-plan aggregation, pre-horizon limitations, and repeated all-four-mode entry. EXTENDED on 2026-09-30: o7 to o9 were added because o2 and o5 no longer reach an effective election under the dated-election gate, and nothing reached inherited-Roth character pools or the five-year deadline coordinator: o7 prices inherited-Roth forced and spending draws against a shared pool, without one, and without a decedent identity; o8 sweeps a verified non-designated five-year account in its deadline year; o9 carries three spousal elections (death-year, mid-year and pre-start) through the election year and into effective S2 rows. REPINNED on 2026-09-04: publishing the discriminated inherited-IRA refusal code added one line inside each of C2.death-evidence, E.legacy and G.identity-and-execution, so those three measured ranges are one line longer than they were -- the added line is the refusalCode publication itself, in each case beside the refusalReason the range already covered. Every other range in this spec moved positionally only. REPINNED on 2026-09-25 (decision D-INHERITED-ROTH-SLICE): the inherited fold now also sums inheritedTraditionalForced, the forced dollars from inherited traditional accounts, so I.delegate (963-1097, now 965-1106) is seven lines longer: the new accumulator and its three-line comment, and the traditional else branch, now braced around a second statement. Every other range in this spec moved positionally only. REPINNED on 2026-09-30 (the election-year section 4974 fix): H.section-4974 gained four lines, a three-line comment and the check that leaves an election-year spousal account out of every beneficiary obligation (Treas. Reg. 1.408-8(c)(3)), so it is now 506-540 and H.section-4974.2 and H2 moved four lines; in I.delegate.2 the five-line per-account filter became a three-line comment and a two-line assignment, so its anchor on that assignment moved three lines.

measuredProof.method: The blocks corpus and both engine source trees are materialized from immutable Git objects, then captured in default, cashFlow, optimizerProbe, and counterfactual modes. The verifier authenticates the proof spec and every transitive mutable equivalence input against both HEAD and the path-normalized working tree before execution, then recomputes corpus, captures, structural comparison, reach, and all recorded hashes. The generic comparator must report IDENTICAL and the independent entry walk must find zero moved entries.
measuredProof.scope: Every blocks-corpus member is byte-identical in all four modes. O6 independently calibrates a lone zero-movement inherited Roth residue as a 0.004 applicable-plan shortfall with a 0.001 section 4974 excise; O3 calibrates three such residues sharing one identity as a 0.012 shortfall with a 0.003 excise. Focused helper tests separately pin those cases plus a 0.01 actual distribution followed by a skipped 0.004 remainder, which remains a 0.004 shortfall with a 0.001 excise. Delegation tests pin immutable snapshotting, grouped duplicate identities, ordered single-write application, runtime journaling, evidence and obligation publication, and hostile failure before caller mutation.

The pin is advanced so the harness closure still authenticates at HEAD; the corpus, capture, reach and calibration figures in this record were measured with the earlier blob and were not re-measured. This proof's engine-tree check already ties it to its own head source tree, so it verifies only at that tree.

It has not been verifiable at main's HEAD since later commits changed packages/engine/src, so HEAD no longer carries the recorded head tree the verifier requires, and re-pinned this spec, so the recorded specMeasurementSha256 no longer matches it. It stands as a historical record of that extraction, not as a check the current engine passes.

readingTheCounts: Member counts prove execution and the reach command additionally fails on cold executable whole lines. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every operand sharing a line, so the report must be read with focused helper, hostile delegation, grouped-duplicate integration, and calibrated-mutation tests. EXCLUSIONS (2026-09-30): every whole line this spec leaves out of its ranges because no plan that parses can execute it is named, with the reason and whatever direct test pins it, in the note of the entry it was cut from; the pieces that continue that entry carry its id with a numeric suffix. The blocks corpus reaches every other line of every range.
